answer: Each node commits before a future drand quicknet pulse; threshold-BLS randomness then derives its challenge parameters, so no operator can know the task early or precompute a stockpile. Verification binds the response to that commitment and a rate-limited, bonded identity, making mass Sybil enrollment costly rather than magically impossible. A swarm cannot offline-farm answers in an inlet, forge them later, or hide its meadow of reused proofs.
